review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines the category structure on `Σ i, C i` through `SigmaHom`, plus `incl`, `desc`, `natTrans`, `natIso`, `map` and `Functor.sigma`. I searched Mathlib for other `Category` instances on sigma types and for other disjoint-union or coproduct-of-categories constructions. I found only this one instance, `instance sigma : Category (Σ i, C i)`. The only other disjoint unions are the binary `CategoryTheory.Sums` and the limits-level `Sigma.desc`/`Sigma.ι`, which are coproducts of objects inside one category. Those are a different concept from this file's coproduct of categories. In `Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sigma/Basic.lean`, `map` and `Functor.sigma` are both defined through `desc`, and they serve different purposes: `map` reindexes the family, while `Functor.sigma` acts on a family of functors. I found no competing duplicate declaration. I did not check the Batteries or Lean core sources for category-theoretic sigma structures, because none are plausible there.
